sentences.text:
This First Appeal filed under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, is
against the judgment and award dated 19.10.2012 passed in Neutral Citation
C/Fa/2842/2014 Conciliation Order

DATED: 08/03/2025 undefined M.A.C.P. No. 1801 of 2005 on the file of Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Aux),
Godhara partially allowing the claim petition or compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
This appeal coming on for conciliation before Lok Adalat, the following order is passed :

CONCILIATION ORDER 1. Learned advocate for the appellant has tendered compromise pursis dated 07.03.2025, which is taken on record, and as per the settlement, the respondent No.
3 agrees to pay Rs.4,00,000/- inclusive of interest towards settlement of the matter and will deposit the said amount with the Tribunal within a period of three months from the date of receipt of the order of this Court and and no further amount is required to be paid to the applicant.
2. In view of the compromise pursis submitted by learned advocate for the parties,
this appeal stands disposed of in terms of the compromise pursis. No order as to costs.
3. Necessary Court fees, if any, be refunded to the appellant, as per the provisions of Section 21(1) of the Legal Services Authority Act, 1987.
4. The order passed in this appeal shall not be treated as precedent.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/2842/2014 CONCILIATION ORDER DATED: 08/03/2025 undefined 5.
Registry is directed to transmit the record and proceedings to the Tribunal forthwith.
(S. V. PINTO,J) CONCILIATOR (TEJAS M. BAROT, DESIGNATED SENIOR ADVOCATE)
